The Centre for Advanced Research on Corporate and Insolvency Laws (CARCIL), CNLU Patna extends its heartfelt gratitude to Mr. Ravi Rajeev Upadhyay, General Counsel at Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co., for serving as the Expert Assessor for the Final Rounds of the CNLU-CARCIL National Deal Negotiation Competition on Fin-tech Law, 2026.

We are sincerely thankful for his time, expertise, and insightful evaluation, which immensely enriched the experience of all the participating teams and contributed to the successful conduct of the competition.

We look forward to continued association.

Prof. (Dr.) Ajay Kumar | Dr. Nandita S Jha | Hardik Awasthi | Shivam Singh | Nikhil Dwivedi | Tejas . | Vishvajeet Rastogi | Saksham Shivam | Tanushree Singhal | Aditya Bhardwaj | Aman Rungta | Shalini Singh | Anuja Chatterjee | Aditya Kumar
comment: Deal negotiation competitions are valuable not just for legal analysis but for exposing students to commercial realities where risk allocation, business objectives, and regulatory constraints often collide.
